entries.name: CID-aware (balanced)
entries.description: Conservative micro-transforms tuned to lower CID match confidence without visible quality loss. Recommended starting point for re-uploads of owned content.
entries.author: yt-uniquifier core

entries.name: CID-aggressive (max divergence)
entries.description: Wider per-segment seed divergence and stronger color/loudnorm jitter. Use when the conservative profile still triggers matches; expect a small VMAF cost.
entries.author: yt-uniquifier core

entries.name: TikTok (vertical 9:16)
entries.description: 9:16 reframe via video.fit_aspect with LUFS target matching TikTok normalisation. Pairs with the auto-tune button in the Run screen.
entries.author: yt-uniquifier core

entries.name: YouTube Shorts (9:16 ≤ 60s)
entries.description: Shorts-friendly geometry and loudnorm target. Trim-warning surfaces in preflight when input exceeds 60 seconds.
entries.author: yt-uniquifier core

entries.name: Soft (minimal transforms)
entries.description: Lowest-impact preset — useful as a baseline for A/B comparisons and for sources where any visible drift is unacceptable.
entries.author: yt-uniquifier core
